basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Junior Consultant, Research Officer Posts
basic_details.short_information: The CM & FM Department of All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar will hold a walk-in interview, tentatively on 2 December 2026 (Wednesday), for one Junior Consultant (Epidemiology) at Rs. 1,04,000 and one Research Officer at Rs. 87,100 per month, both consolidated, on a 4-month contract under the project 'Regional Institute for HIV Surveillance & Epidemiology', working under Dr Arvind Kumar Singh, Additional Professor. Reporting is 10 AM to 11 AM at Room No. 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar, with the filled-in form in hand (advertisement da

how_to_apply: Fill in the prescribed application form attached to the notice (it asks for personal details, educational qualification, current activities, two referees and experience).
Submit a separate application for each post.
Report on 2 December 2026 (tentative) between 10 AM and 11 AM at Room No. 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.
Bring the duly filled-in form, original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates and a passport-size photograph.
Self-attested photocopies of certificates (degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets)

On selection, originals are to be produced for verification at joining: educational qualifications, date of birth, experience certificates, one recent passport-size photograph, identity proof (Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving License etc.), one set of self-attested photocopies of all documents, and SC/ST/OBC/Disability Certificate, if applicable. Candidates who fail to bring original certificates at joining, or whose documents show a discrepancy, will not be allowed to join, and the position will be offered to waiting list candidates.
For queries, call 6372044907 (Smiti Suhani Senapati) or write to [email protected].
important_instructions: Contract appointees have no claim on a regular post in the institute, the Funding Agency or any Department of Government of India, and the contract confers no right to further assignment, transfer to another project or absorption. An undertaking to that effect must be submitted at joining. Continuation or extension depends on the requirement of the Project, performance evaluation and approval of the competent authority, case to case. The engagement can be terminated by one month notice on either side, or forthwith by payment of one-month contractual amount; the notice does not permit surrendering one-month contractual amount in lieu of notice of the unexpired period. Wrong or false information disqualifies the candidature at any stage. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. AIIMS BBSR may cancel or modify the recruitment process at any time. Corrigendum, addendum or further information, if any, will be published on the AIIMS Bhubaneswar website only.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bhubaneswar
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar is a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Sijua, Post Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar-751019. The posts are sanctioned under the project 'Regional Institute for HIV Surveillance & Epidemiology'. The appointment is purely temporary and on contract.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Both posts have a maximum age limit of 35 years. The cut-off date for age is the date of the walk-in interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules; the notice does not print the amount. Qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from an institution of repute, and experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification. Experience working with high-risk groups or hard-to-reach population and good communication skills in Odia, English and Hindi. Experience in working on projects/programs at the state level. Skills in planning and conducting research/survey-related training programmes. Willingness to travel to and stay in different states (Odisha, Andhra Pradesh and Chhattisgarh). Good communication and rapport-building skills with stakeholders. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organization are not eligible to apply. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: MBBS / Master in Public Health / MSc Epidemiology, along with a minimum of three years of experience in disease surveillance / public health management / public health research.

Master of Public Health / Psychology / Social work / Sociology / Anthropology / Rural development or related areas with two years of research experience. Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG Degrees with PhD in Public Health / Psychology / Social work / Sociology / Anthropology / Rural development or related areas.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Consultant (Epidemiology) receives Rs.1,04,000/- consolidated per month and the Research Officer Rs. 87,100/- consolidated per month. The tenure for both posts is 04 months, to be renewed based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds. The notice says the emoluments are as per the guidelines and the sanction. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession and Medical claim are not admissible. Leave applies as per Funding Agency/Institutional policy for contract staff of AIIMS BBSR.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints the same nature of work for both posts: Monitoring and Evaluation of multi-state HIV related surveillance and field activities Supporting program implementation Coordination with stakeholders (NACO, SACS, district health authorities and personnel of healthcare facilities) Capacity building Planning, coordinating and facilitating stakeholder meetings Conducting data quality assessments and data analysis Undertaking reports, technical and scientific writing, publications and PowerPoint presentations Any additional project-related work assigned by the PI

Candidates who fail to bring original certificates at joining, or whose documents show a discrepancy, will not be allowed to join, and the position will be offered to waiting list candidates. For queries, call 6372044907 (Smiti Suhani Senapati) or write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The interview is conducted through offline mode only. The engagement of an applicant for a particular position will be decided by the selection committee/appointing authority. Mere fulfilling the essential/educational qualification does not guarantee selection. The institute reserves the right to consider or reject any application, and the decision of the Director, AIIMS BBSR is final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: one Junior Consultant (Epidemiology) and one Research Officer.

faq.question: Q2. When is the AIIMS Bhubaneswar walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The tentative date is 2 December 2026 (Wednesday), with reporting from 10 AM to 11 AM at Room No. 317, 3rd Floor, CM & FM Department, Academic Building, AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Junior Consultant (Epidemiology)?
faq.answer: MBBS, Master in Public Health or MSc Epidemiology, along with a minimum of three years of experience in disease surveillance, public health management or public health research.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Research Officer?
faq.answer: Master of Public Health / Psychology / Social work / Sociology / Anthropology / Rural development or related areas with two years of research experience, or a Post Graduate Degree including integrated PG Degrees with PhD in those areas.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years for both posts, counted on the date of the walk-in interview. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Junior Consultant (Epidemiology) gets Rs.1,04,000/- consolidated per month and Research Officer gets Rs. 87,100/- consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Bring the duly filled-in application form, original documents, self-attested photocopies of certificates and a passport-size photograph to the walk-in interview. Submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary contract posts for 04 months, to be renewed based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q9. Can government employees in regular service apply?
faq.answer: No. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organization are not eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q10. Are Provident Fund and pension given?
faq.answer: No. Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession and Medical claim are not admissible for contract appointees.
